issue.title: Always include the _index and _id for nested search hits.

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
~~Nested search hits in inner hits do not need the _id and _index attributes,
because it is clear from looking at the root search hit what id and
index these nested search hits have.~~

~~However in the case of top_hits aggregation the nested search hits are
directly returned and are not grouped by a root or parent document, so
it is important to include the _id and _index attributes in order to know
to what documents these nested search hits belong to.~~

Always include the _index and _id of the root document for nested hits.
This information is not really needed for nested hits inside inner hits,
but for nested hits inside `top_hits` aggregation this information is important,
because nested hits are returned outside of the context of their root documents.
Also always include the _index for parent/child inner hits.

PR for #27053

body: @martijnvg  Will you include this fix in a 5.x release as well?
@elwerene This has been backported to the 5.6 branch and this fix will be included in the next 5.6.x release.
@martijnvg @elwerene _id field is again not there in version 6.1.2. Any reason?
